jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Experienced
jobs.description:
**Your Role**

The Medi-Cal Quality Improvement team is responsible for improving preventive care outcomes and increasing member access to quality healthcare services throughout Los Angeles County. The Program Coordinator, Experienced Quality Improvement (HEDIS) will report to the Senior Manager, Medi-Cal Quality Improvement and play a key role in supporting the planning, coordination, and execution of mobile Well Child and Mammogram Clinics at Community Resource Centers (CRCs), provider sites, and community-based locations.

In this role, you will coordinate day-to-day operations related to clinic implementation, scheduling logistics, and performance tracking to help improve preventive care measures, including Well Child Visits, and Breast Cancer Screening.

**This role requires this person to live within 50 miles of the Long Beach office.**

**This is a hybrid field worker role, where this person will be visiting clinics about 75% of the time.**

  

**Your Work**

In this role, you will:

* Coordinate the execution of mobile Well Child and Mammogram Clinics across Community Resource Centers and partner locations throughout Los Angeles County.
* Collaborate with Mobile Clinic Program Manager to ensure clinic readiness and successful event execution.
* Monitor clinic performance metrics, attendance reports, screening completion rates, and HEDIS-related outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain project trackers, clinic dashboards, and databases to support operational and quality improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate meeting logistics, calendars, agendas, and communications for clinic planning and quality improvement activities.
* Assist Quality Improvement Program Managers with implementing strategies designed to improve access to preventive services and achieve departmental and organizational goals.
* Identify and resolve operational barriers related to site location, equipment needs, staffing coordination, and member engagement.
* Collaborate in cross-functional planning efforts with Clinic Program Manager to align mobile clinic operations with Medi-Cal Quality Improvement objectives and community health priorities.
* Manage multiple clinic initiatives simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and customer service.
* Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders and synthesize information from multiple sources to support informed decision-making and successful program implementation.
* Manage support tasks such as monitoring the provider services email box, provider fax blasts, member incentive reconciliation, care gap report quality assurance review, etc.

  

**Your Knowledge and Experience**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
* Requires 3 years of prior relevant experience
* This person is required to live within 50 miles of the Long Beach office
* Basic understanding of HEDIS Quality measures preferred
* Member and/or community facing experience preferred
* Bilingual (Spanish) preferred
* Requires a solid understanding of project and resource management, strong business acumen, and team focus.
* Intermediate skill in MS Office products (including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Word)
* Beginner level proficiency in the management of small to medium internal databases, including demonstrated ability to create and manipulate spreadsheets and databases, as well as using graphic software to display results

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

jobs.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker - Parent/Caregiver Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Description**

The UCLA Health Rape Treatment Center provides specialized services for child and adult victims of sexual assault and abuse and conducts prevention, education, and professional training designed to reduce sexual violence and strengthen community response. Prevention programming includes education for youth and other community audiences, training and consultation for schools and partner organizations, and collaboration with community and professional systems.

Come join our outreach team as a Parent/Caregiver Program Coordinator and make a difference in the community. This key role will develop, coordinate, and deliver sexual abuse prevention education to parents and caregivers.

Key duties include:

* Identifying opportunities to reach parent/caregiver audiences through community organizations, healthcare, schools and child-serving settings, and other community-based venues
* Assesses prevention-education needs and develops programming responsive to those needs.
* Creating and adapting prevention curricula and materials, facilitating workshops and trainings, developing community partnerships, evaluating program effectiveness, and contributing to ongoing program improvement.
* Uses trauma informed approaches to respond appropriately to disclosures, connect families with clinical advocacy and community resources and supports caregiver engagement services.
* Contributes to grant reporting and data requirements.
* Regularly travels to local schools, community organizations, partner agencies, and other program sites throughout Los Angeles County; occasionally travel outside the local area may be required for training, meetings, or other program-related activities.
* Participation in the RTC/Stuart House 24-hour on-call response system, including approximately 1-2 weekday overnight on-call shifts per month.

UCLA Health is a world-renowned health system with four award-winning hospitals and dozens of primary care practices, specialty practices, urgent care centers and other ancillary locations throughout metro Los Angeles. We are also home to the David Geffen School of Medicine, an internationally respected leader in medical education and research. Through the efforts of our outstanding people, we have become Los Angeles’ trusted provider of exceptional, compassionate patient care.

Pay Range: $58.41 - $69.80 hourly

  
Pay range: $58.41 - $69.80 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Master of Social Work (MSW) degree from an accredited institution and current California Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
* Bilingual English/Spanish proficiency sufficient to deliver prevention programming and communicate effectively with participants (ability to successfully complete the UCLA language proficiency assessment)
* 2+ years providing education, support, outreach or programming primarily to parent/caregivers or families
* Experience developing and facilitating educational programs, workshops, curricula, or training materials
* Experience in childhood trauma, child sexual abuse, or related prevention programming
* Live Scan Fingerprint screening, Criminal Record, Sex Offender Registry, and Child Abuse Index Clearance
* Per funding agency requirements and alliances, all staff must complete background checks at least every five years that includes, sex offender registry check, State or FBI criminal history check, including fingerprint check, child abuse and neglect state registry check if available in the state of California.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with parents/caregivers, schools, community organizations, healthcare providers, and multidisciplinary partners.
* Strong written communication, organizational, project-management, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in community and off-site settings while managing multiple concurrent activities and deadlines.

**Preferred:** Experience working with parents/caregivers and community-based organizations.

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world's leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

jobs.title: Med Spa Front Desk & Sales Coordinator — Santa Monica ($20–$25/hr + Commission)
jobs.description:
Med Spa Front Desk & Sales Coordinator  
Santa Monica, CA · 4 Days/Week (Saturday Required) · $20–$25/hr + 5% Commission

About Dripology  
Dripology is a luxury med spa and IV therapy brand with locations in Santa Monica and New York City. All treatments are RN-led and physician-supervised. We serve everyone from everyday wellness clients to celebrities, and we've been featured in The Hollywood Reporter, InStyle, The Cut and Us Weekly. We're growing quickly, with new locations and franchising underway, and we're looking for an experienced front desk and sales professional to grow with us.

Please Read Before Applying  
This is not an entry-level position, and we do not provide basic training. You need to have worked at the front desk or in consultative sales at another med spa. You should already know the treatments, the client questions and the sales process. If you don't have prior med spa experience, this role isn't the right fit.

The Role  
You are both the face of the clinic and the person who books the business. You'll create a five-star experience for every client who walks in or calls. You'll also lead consultations that turn inquiries into booked treatments, packages and memberships. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, spots opportunities and adds value from their first week.

Responsibilities

*Front Desk & Client Experience*

* Greet and check in clients with a warm, polished, luxury level of hospitality
* Answer phones, texts, DMs and web inquiries quickly and professionally
* Manage the schedule, bookings, confirmations, cancellations and waitlists
* Handle check-out, payments, deposits and package redemptions
* Keep the front of house clean, stocked and client-ready at all times

*Sales & Consultations*

* Lead consultations in person, by phone and by video to understand client goals and recommend treatment plans
* Convert leads, inquiries and consults into booked appointments
* Sell treatment packages, series and memberships
* Follow up on open consults, no-shows and past clients to drive rebookings
* Track your leads and conversions, and work toward monthly sales goals

*Marketing & Growth*

* Promote monthly specials, events and new treatments
* Support social media, content days and in-clinic events
* Share client feedback and trends with leadership to help shape offers

*Team Support*

* Work closely with our nurses, injectors and NPs to keep the day running smoothly
* Communicate client needs, pre-care and post-care instructions, and scheduling changes clearly

Treatments You Must Already Know  
You should be able to explain each of these to a client with confidence:

* Botox/Dysport and dermal fillers
* Microneedling and RF microneedling
* Laser hair removal
* PRP/PRFM
* IPL photofacials, chemical peels, RF skin tightening and body contouring
* IV therapy and NAD+ (a plus; we're happy to teach our specific menu)

Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

* At least 1 year of front desk, patient coordinator or sales experience at a med spa
* Proven consultative sales experience, with a track record of converting consults into booked treatments
* Strong working knowledge of Botox, filler, microneedling, laser hair removal and PRP
* Availability 4 days per week, including every Saturday
* Professional, reliable and always on time
* Polished communication skills in person, on the phone and in writing
* A self-starter who works without hand-holding

Nice to Have

* Experience with Boulevard or similar booking software (Zenoti, Mangomint, Vagaro)
* Experience selling memberships and packages
* Comfort with Instagram and social media
* Bilingual (English/Spanish)

Compensation & Perks

* $20–$25/hour, based on experience
* 5% commission on sales
* Exclusive perks on Dripology treatments and services
* A beautiful Santa Monica clinic and a high-profile clientele
* Room to grow into a leadership role as we expand

Schedule  
4 days per week, Saturday required. Clinic hours are Monday–Saturday, 10AM–5PM.

Location  
1411 7th St, Santa Monica, CA 90401 (in person)

How to Apply  
Submit your resume along with a short note (3–5 sentences) that answers these questions:

* Which med spa(s) have you worked at, and in what role?
* Which treatments did you sell most, and roughly how many consults did you convert per month?
* Can you confirm you're available on Saturdays?

Applications without med spa experience or without the note will not be considered.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Santa Monica, CA 90401

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator - Pomona Housing
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** M-F 9:30AM-6PM (can be flexible anytime 8AM-7PM)
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
Building on this mission, the Prototypes Housing, a program of HealthRIGHT 360, provides housing and case management services for women and women with children across Los Angeles County through three core programs that support clients along the housing continuum. Recovery Bridge Housing (RBH) offers short-term, recovery-focused interim housing for unhoused adults and perinatal women engaged in outpatient substance use treatment, emphasizing life skills development within a 90-day period to promote long-term stability. The Bridge Housing program serves individuals with behavioral health needs who are experiencing homelessness by providing interim housing and supportive services until they secure permanent placement. The Continuum of Care (COC), funded through LAHSA, delivers permanent housing solutions focused on sustained stability for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. Across all programs, Prototypes provides comprehensive case management, including assessments, individualized service planning, resource linkage, and ongoing support to help clients achieve lasting recovery and housing stability.
  
  
Aligned with HealthRIGHT 360’s mission to advance health equity and the Prototypes Housing continuum serving women and families across Los Angeles County, the Administrative Coordinator supports daily operations that ensure safe, stable housing by maintaining housing readiness, tracking client census and bed availability, coordinating unit turnover, and managing maintenance requests. This role also supports administrative functions by maintaining documentation systems, managing workflows and supply levels, and coordinating communication across multidisciplinary teams to support efficient service delivery and positive client housing outcomes in alignment with HealthRIGHT 360’s mission and values.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Housing Operations Support
  

* Maintain daily client census and track bed availability to support admissions and program flow.
* Ensure unit readiness by coordinating room turnover, cleanliness, and appropriate housing conditions.
* Submit and track maintenance requests; follow up to ensure timely completion of repairs. This may include traveling to off-site RBH locations in Pomona.
* Collaborate with supervisors and managers to optimize housing utilization and client placement.
* Maintain inventory of housing supplies including toiletries, linens, and bedding.
* Monitor supply levels and coordinate replenishment to ensure consistent availability for clients.
* Organize and manage storage areas to ensure accessibility and efficiency.
* Transport clients if necessary.

Office Support
  

* Maintain office organization, including filing systems and administrative processes.
* Support overall office efficiency by coordinating tasks and improving workflow systems.
* Assist with documentation and internal administrative tracking as needed.

Collaboration
  

* Serve as a liaison between administrative offices and program departments, including Outpatient and Residential teams.
* Facilitate clear and consistent communication to support daily operations and client care.
* Work closely with supervisors and management to address operational needs and priorities.

Compliance
  

* Maintain and uphold all applicable HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 regulations.
* Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of client and organizational information.
* Follow all organizational policies and procedures related to documentation and privacy.
* Attend and complete assigned trainings.
* Attend and participate in meetings and events.
* Read and respond to emails in a timely manner.

And perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
Credentials
  

* High school diploma or equivalent required. Higher education preferred.
* Valid First Aid and CPR certification or ability to obtain within the required timeline.
* Valid California Driver’s License and access to registered and insured transportation.

Experience
  

* Minimum of two years’ experience in an administrative or clerical role.
* Experience and demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

jobs.description:
Administrative Coordinator

*Anaheim, CA*  
*Full-time | Monday–Friday | 8:30am–5:00pm*  
*Office-based | Permanent position*

A busy office involves more than completing individual tasks. Meetings need to be coordinated, requests need to reach the right people, and deadlines need to stay visible even when priorities change. We’re looking for an Administrative Coordinator in Anaheim, CA to help connect these moving parts and keep everyday business activities on track.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys organizing information, communicating with different teams, and making sure important details don’t get missed. Rather than focusing solely on data entry or filing, you’ll help coordinate schedules, monitor outstanding tasks, and support the smooth running of daily office operations.

Day to Day

* Coordinate meetings, appointments, and calendar updates across the team.
* Track deadlines, outstanding requests, and upcoming administrative priorities.
* Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, and internal correspondence.
* Communicate updates between departments and follow up when information is needed.
* Maintain shared schedules, contact lists, and administrative tracking systems.
* Organize project documents and ensure team members can access the information they need.
* Monitor office requests and direct them to the appropriate person for action.
* Assist with onboarding paperwork, internal meetings, and routine team activities.
* Review administrative processes and identify practical ways to improve organization.
* Coordinate office supplies, service requests, and other routine operational needs.
* Keep records of completed tasks, upcoming deadlines, and important decisions.
* Handle business information professionally and maintain appropriate confidentiality.

What’s Important

You’ll need strong organizational skills, clear communication, and the ability to keep several tasks moving without losing track of the details. Confidence using email, spreadsheets, calendars, and standard office software is important.

Previous administrative coordination, office administration, reception, customer service, project support, or general business support experience is useful, although training on internal systems and procedures will be provided.

We’re looking for someone who can take initiative, follow up on outstanding work, adjust when priorities change, and work effectively with different people. Being dependable and knowing when to ask questions or escalate an issue will also help you succeed.

Please apply with your current resume to be considered for the Administrative Coordinator position.

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider qualified applicants in accordance with applicable law.

Pay: $21.50 - $25.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off
* Parental leave

**The Opportunity**

**Position Title:** Outreach Coordinator

**Department:** Development

**Location:** Anaheim, CA

**Reports To:** Outreach Manager

**Classification:** Non-Exempt

**Status:** Part-Time, up to 30 hours per week

**Compensation:** $28.16–$35.20/hourly commensurate with skills and experience

**Join the team behind the mission**

Every day, people across California turn to the Council on American-Islamic Relations, California (CAIR-CA) when they face discrimination, threats to their civil rights, or challenges to their freedom to practice their faith. As the largest Muslim civil rights and advocacy organization in California, we protect constitutional rights, advance justice, and empower communities through legal advocacy, public policy, civic engagement, and education.

Since 1994, that work has been made possible by a dedicated team committed to serving individuals, families, and communities across California. Behind every case, campaign, and initiative are people working together to create meaningful change.

Whether you serve clients directly or support our mission behind the scenes, your work helps build a more just, inclusive, and equitable California.

**Why CAIR-CA**

**Meaningful Work:** Your work directly contributes to protecting civil rights, advancing justice, and strengthening communities throughout California.

**Collaborative Culture:** Team members value respect, teamwork, innovation, and continuous learning.

**Professional Growth:** We support your development through mentorship and opportunities to expand your skills and impact.

jobs.title: Technology Account Manager, IT Managed Services (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Description:

**About GoodSuite**

GoodSuite is a boutique technology services company with 28 years of operating history, headquartered in Woodland Hills, CA. We serve businesses across Southern California with managed IT services, imaging solutions, AV, and emerging technology offerings. With a 95%+ client retention rate and a culture built on ownership, speed, and continuous development, we are on an aggressive growth path toward $25M in revenue by 2027.

*We operate with a Mamba Mentality — we outwork, out-think, and out-serve. We are not looking for someone to maintain the status quo. We are looking for someone to help us redefine what’s possible.*

**Position Summary**

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as the strategic owner of assigned IT client accounts, acting as GoodSuite's primary advisor and long-term technology partner. As a trusted technology advisor, the TAM is responsible for building strong executive relationships, maintaining an active technology roadmap, aligning client environments to GoodSuite standards, and driving long-term client success.

This is a growth role. The TAM is accountable for retention, client satisfaction, and new revenue, achieved through project delivery, roadmap execution, security improvements, and recurring service expansion. In addition to managing a portfolio of 30 to 35 IT clients, the TAM is expected to actively pursue new IT business within GoodSuite's large base of imaging and print clients who do not yet use our IT services.

The TAM serves as the client advocate and escalation point inside GoodSuite, ensuring service delivery teams have the context and prioritization needed to support the client effectively. While the TAM maintains strategic oversight of service quality, the role does not manage day-to-day ticket dispatch or service coordination, allowing the TAM to remain focused on account development and growth.

**Account Growth & Revenue Responsibility**

The TAM is responsible for driving revenue growth against a monthly new revenue target. All new revenue counts toward this target, whether it comes from the assigned IT portfolio or from imaging clients converted to IT services.

Projects are a primary growth driver for this role. The TAM is expected to consistently identify, scope, propose, and close project work, including:

* Technology lifecycle refresh initiatives
* Infrastructure modernization and cloud migration projects
* Cybersecurity posture improvements and compliance initiatives
* Professional services and project delivery
* Expansion of managed services and recurring service agreements
* Hardware, licensing, and platform optimization aligned to GoodSuite standards

The TAM follows a consistent account development model across every client, using roadmap planning, quarterly business reviews, and lifecycle management to identify and advance opportunities.

Each TAM is expected to maintain a forward-looking project pipeline at all times, with multiple project opportunities actively in progress, ensuring ongoing modernization, security maturity improvements, and infrastructure alignment with GoodSuite best practices.

**Client Base Expansion (New IT Growth)**

GoodSuite serves a large base of imaging and print clients who already trust us but do not yet use our IT services. The TAM is expected to hunt within this base, opening new IT relationships and converting them into managed services and project clients.

* Work a defined target list of imaging clients each quarter, prioritized by IT fit and opportunity size
* Partner with imaging account representatives on warm introductions, joint visits, and account planning
* Lead discovery conversations, IT assessments, and security reviews to uncover needs and create opportunities
* Use projects and assessments as entry points to establish new IT relationships
* Build proposals and convert opportunities into managed services agreements and project work
* Maintain an accurate, current opportunity pipeline in Salesforce with clear stages and next steps

Expected time allocation: approximately 70% portfolio management and growth, 30% client base expansion.

**Strategic Advisory**

* Serve as a trusted technology advisor to client leadership, developing a deep understanding of their business operations, goals, and IT environment
* Translate technology requirements into clear, actionable business solutions that deliver measurable value
* Advise clients on IT architecture, cybersecurity strategy, lifecycle planning, and technology investments aligned with their business objectives
* Develop and maintain a documented technology roadmap and budget forecast for each assigned client
* Educate client leadership on emerging technology trends, cybersecurity risks, and operational best practices
* Bring in GoodSuite engineering and leadership resources for complex architecture and strategy decisions

**Standards, Security, and Lifecycle Governance**

* Maintain a current 'baseball card' technical profile for each client environment documenting infrastructure standards and security posture
* Evaluate client environments against GoodSuite standards and identify improvement opportunities
* Drive remediation of security, infrastructure, and lifecycle risks through structured improvement plans
* Partner with service leadership and engineering teams to implement security improvements and best-practice configurations
* Ensure lifecycle planning for critical infrastructure including servers, networking, security platforms, and endpoint environments
* Maintain an active multi-year technology roadmap for each client

**Strategic Account Management**

* Own the long-term strategic relationship with assigned clients including executive and operational stakeholders
* Maintain a living technology roadmap and improvement plan for each account
* Conduct structured Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) reviewing roadmap progress, service trends, and upcoming initiatives
* Identify and advance technology

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 15 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role.
* Experience with core cloud computing concepts and enterprise architecture principles, including networking (VPC, peering), compute, storage, IT security (IAM, segmentation, encryption), database systems, cloud-native application development, and operational frameworks.
* Experience presenting to technical and executive stakeholders, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting customers in critical cloud operations domains, including launch/capacity planning, product release management, technical support, or formalized escalation management procedures.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master's degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Relevant technical professional certifications.
* Experience leading technical governance activities, such as establishing or actively participating in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), or developing reference architectures and reusable patterns for an enterprise organization.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Technical Success Account Manager (TSAM), you will serve as a strategic technical leader aligned with Google Cloud’s most critical customers. You are responsible for driving sustained platform health, achieving technical excellence, and ensuring stability for key business critical workloads running on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

The TSAM serves as the customer’s trusted technical advisor, translating complex business objectives into rigorous technical governance and modern, resilient cloud architectural strategies. You will advocate for adoption of industry best practices and act as the primary point of accountability for resolving platform challenges and proactive risk mitigation, to the satisfaction of executive stakeholders.

This role requires independently forging strong executive relationships, advocating for the implementation of Google Cloud architecture standards, elevating platform stability, and establishing technical accuracy across the customer’s GCP footprint, through a programmatic approach. Additionally, you will serve as the internal customer advocate, translating their strategic needs into actionable feedback for Google Cloud’s Product and Engineering teams, ensuring continuous service improvement and feature development.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $224000 - $311000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Establish and lead Technical Governance, focusing on platform health metrics and enterprise readiness planning.
* Provide technical guidance and advocate for the adoption of Google Cloud architecture and best practices via deep dives and workshops.
* Drive platform stability and excellence through deep architectural health assessments.
* Serve as the strategic technical advisor to address and resolve critical reliability concerns, advising on and guiding the architecture of highly robust, scalable, and resilient workloads.
* Act as the internal customer advocate, translating technical obstacles to influence GCP product roadmaps. Own workload success, stabilization, and ongoing optimization to ensure sustained business value.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Customer Service and Account Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job Title:** Customer Service and Account Manager  
**Department:** Account Management  
**Reports To:** General Manager  
**Location:** Anaheim, CA  
**Effective/Revision Date:** October 8, 2026

**Role Purpose**

The Customer Service and Account Manager is responsible for leading and supervising the Customer Account Management team to ensure effective management of existing customer accounts, timely customer communication, accurate order processing, and fulfillment of customer commitments.

This position provides direction, coaching, and performance oversight while collaborating with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Planning, and Business Development to resolve customer concerns, improve operational efficiency, strengthen customer relationships, and support continuous improvement throughout the order-to-delivery lifecycle.

**Scope & Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Team Leadership & Supervision**

* Lead, supervise, coach, and develop Customer Account Managers to ensure consistent service delivery and achievement of departmental objectives.
* Establish performance expectations, assign responsibilities, monitor workloads, and ensure accountability for individual and team performance.
* Conduct performance evaluations, provide ongoing feedback, address performance concerns, and coordinate corrective actions with Human Resources.
* Participate in employee recruitment, hiring, onboarding, training, and professional development.
* Conduct regular team meetings and coaching sessions to review priorities, customer activities, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities.
* Promote a collaborative, customer-focused environment that encourages accountability, teamwork, and employee development.

**Customer Account Management**

* Oversee daily account management activities, ensuring timely and accurate responses to customer inquiries, order updates, delivery schedules, and service requests.
* Ensure Customer Account Managers maintain positive relationships with existing customers through proactive communication and effective issue resolution.
* Serve as the management-level escalation point for complex customer concerns and coordinate appropriate resolutions with internal departments.
* Ensure customer requirements, expectations, and contractual commitments are accurately communicated and managed.
* Monitor customer account activities to identify service risks, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve customer satisfaction and retention.

**Order Management, Quoting & Forecasting**

* Oversee the processing and coordination of customer purchase orders, order acknowledgments, order changes, and related documentation.
* Supervise estimating and quoting coordination for existing customer accounts to ensure accurate and timely responses.
* Oversee customer demand forecasting activities, including reviewing forecasts and communicating changes in demand to Production, Planning, and Supply Chain.
* Collaborate with Operations and Planning to monitor production schedules, delivery commitments, and customer priorities.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of customer account information, order records, forecasts, and related documentation within company systems.
* Identify and resolve order discrepancies, forecasting concerns, and communication gaps that may impact customer commitments.

**Cross-Functional Coordination & Issue Resolution**

* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, and other departments to resolve customer concerns involving product quality, delivery, order accuracy, and changing requirements.
* Facilitate communication between Customer Account Managers and internal departments to maintain alignment on customer expectations and operational capabilities.
* Support Business Development and New Product Introduction (NPI) teams in transitioning new customer programs into ongoing account management.
* Escalate significant customer concerns, operational risks, and unresolved issues to the General Manager as appropriate.
* Identify recurring service challenges and coordinate corrective actions and process improvements.

**Departmental Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish, monitor, and report on departmental performance indicators related to customer responsiveness, order accuracy, forecasting, issue resolution, and service effectiveness.
* Evaluate account management processes and team performance to identify opportunities for increased efficiency and improved customer service.
* Develop and maintain standardized procedures, communication practices, and workflows.
* Ensure effective utilization of ERP, CRM, and other business systems to support accurate recordkeeping and efficient operations.
* Provide regular departmental performance updates, customer account status reports, and recommendations to the General Manager.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen customer satisfaction, internal coordination, and departmental effectiveness.
* Perform assigned duties in accordance with documented company procedures, policies, and work instructions.

**Work Experience & Skills**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

**Experience:**

* 5–7 years of progressive experience in customer account management, customer service, sales operations, or related functions, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum 2–3 years of direct supervisory or management experience, including employee coaching, performance management, and team development.
* Experience supporting customer accounts within a manufacturing or engineered-products environment strongly preferred.

**Skills / Knowledge:**

* Strong leadership, supervisory, coaching, and employee development skills.
* Knowledge of manufacturing operations, order management

On site, you’ll check productions in and wrap them out, keep the stage clean and stocked, and take care of clients while they shoot. Online, you’ll turn what happens here into content that brings filmmakers, photographers, musicians and brands through our doors. We want someone who loves this space and wants to help build a real community of creatives around the studio and its almost 11-year history.

Responsibilities

**1. Studio site management (core)**

* Open the studio and check in productions: walk them through the space, power, house rules and safety.
* Check house gear in and out (grip, electric, furniture, props) against each booking.
* Run check in and wrap out: note add ons and damage, missing items or overtime, confirm the space is restored, trash is out and close out the booking.
* Be the on-site point of contact while clients shoot: answer questions, solve problems, troubleshoot G&E basics.
* Light cleaning and reset between bookings: floors, touch-ups, green room and restrooms.
* Track inventory of gear, expendables and supplies; flag repairs and reorder needs.

**2. Social media and content (core)**

* Own the studio’s social channels: plan, shoot, edit and post content on a regular schedule.
* Capture behind-the-scenes photos and video on shoot days, with client permission.
* Train other staff to capture behind-the-scenes content.
* Grow followers and engagement, and showcase the studio to production companies, labels and agencies.
* Track what’s working and share simple monthly results.

**3. Community and growth**

* Log client contacts, bookings and follow-ups in HubSpot.
* Introduce production companies, music labels, and marketing and ad agencies to the studio.
* Help plan and host community events, meetups and screenings.

What we’re looking for

**Required**

* Proven social media skills: shooting and editing short-form video, posting consistently and growing an audience. Please share accounts you’ve run and metrics.
* Studio site management and/or film, commercial or photo production experience.
* Comfortable being the point person with clients: calm, friendly and solution-focused under pressure.
* Organized and detail-oriented with check-ins, inventory and paperwork.
* Able to lift 30 lbs.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Comfortable with photo and video editing tools.
* Working knowledge of grip and electric: stands, flags, rigging basics, lighting, power distribution and set safety.

**Bonus points**

* An existing network of production companies, music labels, and marketing and advertising agencies.
* A genuine desire to help build a community of creatives around the studio.

Schedule and pay

* **Employment type:** Part-time, hourly, non-exempt (W-2)
* **Hours:** About 10–40 hours per week, depending on bookings
* **Shift length:** 4–13 hours, based on bookings
* **Pay:** $22–$26/hour (good-faith range, based on experience)
* **Overtime:** 1.5x after 8 hours a day or 40 a week; 2x after 12 hours a day
* **Location:** On site, Downtown LA (DTLA) area

This is a part-time role with flexible hours. Expect some early calls, late wraps and weekends.

How to apply

Send your resume to **siterepjob@gmail.com**. Include links to social accounts you’ve run (with metrics), a few lines on why this role interests you and the community you’d bring with you, and your general weekly availability.

The studio is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative and the California Fair Chance Act.

Pay: $22.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 10.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

* Coordinate and schedule inbound and outbound shipments, including truck and rail transportation.

* Monitor inventory levels and proactively identify potential supply chain challenges.

This role requires independently forging strong executive relationships, advocating for the implementation of Google Cloud architecture standards, elevating platform stability, and establishing technical accuracy across the customer’s GCP footprint, through a programmatic approach. Additionally, you will serve as the internal customer advocate, translating their strategic needs into actionable feedback for Google Cloud’s Product and Engineering teams, ensuring continuous service improvement and feature development.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. The position combines executive support, office operations, contractor licensing coordination, event planning, and collaboration with administrative and shared-service partners across Milender White and Graham. **About Plasmidsaurus**

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.

We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.

Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.

Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.

**Role Overview**
=================

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Merch, Events, and Brand Experience, you'll scale the in-person presence that puts our sequencing services directly in front of the scientists who use them every day. You'll own execution across our field marketing calendar, including major scientific conferences, sales account-based events, and a new North American roadshow program, turning each one into an on-brand touchpoint that builds pipeline and deepens trust with our scientific community.

This is a hands-on role for someone who's as comfortable packing a booth crate and running a load-in as they are building a run-of-show or briefing a booth team. We build our own booths and don't rely on external events agencies. Within your first year, you'll run a major conference on your own and build programs that don't exist yet.

Based in South San Francisco, 3 days a week in the office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Tradeshow & Conference Execution**

* Plan and execute our tradeshow calendar of major scientific conferences and society meetings, such as ASHG, AACR, PAG, and ASM.
* Design and build our booths, from layout to on-site setup.
* Own booth logistics, shipping, signage, staffing schedules, and lead capture across single-booth, double-booth, and international formats.
* Brief and direct booth teams of about 10, including scientists and executives, on messaging, demos, and goals.
* Coordinate show organizers, general contractors, AV, and catering directly, on time and on budget.
* Serve as event project manager before each show, coordinating across Marketing, Sales, Product, R&D, and leadership.
* Take conferences on your own when the calendar overlaps.

### **Field Marketing & Sales Events**

* Develop, plan, and execute field marketing programs: sales account-based events, roadshows, and regional user meetings.
* Design and build a North American roadshow program from scratch.
* Take sales-led events beyond today's playbook, raising the brand bar at each one.
* Coordinate logistics from venue sourcing through teardown.
* Align events with Sales account priorities and pipeline goals, and own lead handoff and follow-up.
* Build a multi-channel outreach and promotional plan for each event.
* Work with the social media team on event content, including attendee sharing.

### **Operations & Reporting**

* Own budgets, vendor and venue coordination, contracts, timelines, and shipping.
* Track leads, cost per lead, and attendee feedback, and use them to improve future events.
* Help build and maintain the field marketing calendar and budget tracker, flagging risks early.

### **Brand & On-Site Staffing**

* Work with Brand and Design so booths, signage, and collateral reflect our brand and voice.
* Travel to events, including evenings and weekends around show dates, to lead setup, staffing, and teardown.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

### **The First Three Months**

You've worked our January conferences, including the prep, and know how our booth comes together. You’ve learned the process of running a conference from prep to execution to measurement and debrief, the Plasmidsaurus way.

### **Within Six Months**

You've worked four major conferences across single-booth, double-booth, and international formats and are ready to lead one. Booth teams, including senior staff, follow your direction with confidence.

### **Within One Year**

You've run a major conference on your own and supported every show on our calendar. Sales-led events get hands-on support and are as on-brand as our conferences. jobs.description:
Overview:

Marin Community Clinics, founded in 1972, is today, a multi-clinic network with a wide array of integrated primary care, dental, behavioral, specialty and referral services. As a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), we provide vital health services to almost 40,000 individuals annually in Marin County. The Clinics regularly receive national awards from the Health Resources and Services Administrations (HRSA). Our Mission is to promote health and wellness through excellent, compassionate care for all.

The Credentialing and Licensing Coordinator maintains MCC's organizational licenses, permits, registrations, and regulatory records and supports initial credentialing and recredentialing for clinical staff. The position coordinates complete, timely files for review and approval, monitors expirations and renewal cycles, and escalates barriers that could affect workforce readiness or clinic operations.

Responsibilities:

**Licensing and Permit Administration**

* Maintain an accurate inventory, renewal calendar, required postings, and audit-ready files for licenses, permits, registrations, certificates, fees, and agency correspondence.
* Coordinate applications, renewals, amendments, relocations, service changes, closures, and terminations within required timeframes.
* Support applicable California Department of Public Health (CDPH), California State Board of Pharmacy, laboratory, radiologic, dental, medical-waste, hazardous-material, fire, occupancy, and local business requirements.
* Monitor agency communications and promptly escalate questions, deficiencies, or time-sensitive issues to accountable leaders and Compliance, as appropriate.
* Coordinate with HRSA scope, payer enrollment, NPI, Facilities, Finance, Pharmacy, and other owners to keep site and service information align.

**I****nitial Credentialing and Recredentialing**

* Coordinate initial credentialing and recredentialing for licensed independent practitioners and other assigned clinical workforce members in accordance with MCC policy and applicable accreditation, HRSA, and payer requirements.
* Collect and review applications, attestations, disclosures, supporting documents, and requested updates; identify omissions, inconsistencies, and items requiring follow-up.
* Complete and document required primary-source verifications, including licensure, education, training, board status, work history, references, sanctions, exclusions, malpractice history, NPDB, and DEA or CURES information when applicable.
* Monitor expiring credentials and recredentialing cycles; conduct timely outreach and escalate incomplete or overdue requirements before they affect eligibility to practice.
* Maintain accurate provider demographics, credentialing data, verification dates, documents, status, and workflow activity in the approved credentialing system.
* Protect confidential credentialing, peer-review, workforce, and provider information in accordance with MCC requirements.

**Privileging and Approval Support**

* Prepare complete credentialing and privileging files, summaries, reports, and agenda materials for Credentialing and Privileging Committee and other required approval bodies.
* Coordinate initial, renewed, or revised privileges so requested services, sites, competencies, and supporting documentation are clearly presented for review.
* Obtain required competency, peer-review, OPPE, FPPE, or other reappointment information from responsible clinical leaders when applicable.
* Document approvals, conditions, effective dates, expiration dates, and follow-up actions; credentialing and privileging decisions remain with authorized committees and leaders.

**Records, Readiness, and Collaboration**

* Maintain organized, audit-ready credentialing and licensing records and produce reports for leadership, committee, survey, audit, and operational needs.
* Coordinate with clinical leadership, Human Resources, Payer Enrollment, Compliance, Operations, Quality, and others to resolve dependencies and maintain aligned records.
* Communicate requirements and deadlines clearly, track assigned actions, and escalate unresolved risks or delays through the defined management pathway.
* Perform other related duties and projects as assigned.

Qualifications:

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, public administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered.
* Three years of healthcare credentialing, licensing, medical staff services, accreditation, regulatory operations, or related experience desired.
* Experience with primary-source verification, credentialing databases, expiration tracking, committee preparation, and confidential records.
* FQHC or multi-site ambulatory healthcare experience and familiarity with California licensing, HRSA, payer, and Joint Commission requirements preferred.
* National Association Medical Staff Services (NAMSS) credentialing education or certification.
* Bilingual English/Spanish skills preferred.

**Required Skills and Abilities**

* Strong organization, accuracy, attention to detail, follow-through, and deadline management.
* Ability to interpret requirements, identify missing or inconsistent information, and maintain defensible documentation.
* Sound judgment regarding when to proceed, verify, pause, or escalate.
* Clear written and verbal communication and ability to coordinate work across clinical and administrative teams.
* Proficiency with credentialing systems, Microsoft 365, shared repositories, spreadsheets, and reporting tools.
* Professional discretion, adaptability, and commitment to patient-centered service, integrity, and continuous improvement.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions**

* Fulfill immunization and fit for duty regulatory requirements.
* Office and clinic-based work with regular travel between MCC sites and occasional early-morning or evening meetings.

**About Team**

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and advancing toward AGI-level intelligence in dynamic factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the physical constraints of real-world systems to improve people’s lives.

**About Role**

We’re looking for a Procurement Coordinator to support the day-to-day purchasing and logistics needs of our Robotics organization. You’ll follow up on orders, coordinate domestic and international shipments, work with suppliers and logistics providers, and keep the details organized from purchase request through delivery.

This is an entry-level position for someone who is organizeded.

You’ll also help improve how we work. We expect you to adopt AI tools and build practical automations that reduce repetitive tasks, improve visibility, and make the supply chain team more effective. This role offers an opportunity to build a foundation in procurement, logistics, and hardware operations.

**This role is based in San Francisco, CA and requires in-person presence 4 days a week and up to 10% travel to vendor sites.**

**In this role you will:**

* Follow up with internal teams to keep purchase requests and PO issuance moving on timeation, and confirm that suppliers receive and acknowledge orders.
* Track open orders through delivery, maintain accurate supplier commitments, and proactively follow up on lead times, shipment dates, and overdue items.
* Coordinate domestic and international logistics, including scheduling couriers, arranging pickups, booking shipments, tracking deliveries, and resolving shipping exceptions.
* Prepare and check commercial invoices, packing lists, and other shipping documentation. Work with suppliers, customs brokers, and internal specialists to address customs questions and support timely clearance.
* Manage day-to-day coordination with third-party logistics providers (3PLs), including receiving, storage, outbound shipments, and resolving inventory or delivery discrepancies.
* Keep purchasing and logistics records current, communicate clear status updates, and help resolve order discrepancies, returns, and missing delivery documentation.

Position: Development Coordinator

Reports to: Director of Development

Status: Non-Exempt, Non-Union

Location: Main Headquarters, 1171 Mission St

Salary: $73,000-$75,000

Founded in 1978, Community Forward SF is a multi-site organization providing innovative and inclusive shelter, housing, mental health care, and supportive services for people experiencing homelessness and housing instability across San Francisco. Our mission is to empower women and all people to break cycles of housing instability and violence. For nearly five decades, we have met people where they are—providing safety, resources, and support they need to move toward stability and home.

Position Summary: As part of the Development team, the Development Coordinator supports Community Forward SF’s fundraising efforts by processing donations; maintaining donor records, preparing reports, coordinating communications and events logistics; and supporting donor stewardship and engagement. Under the direction of the Director of Development, the Coordinator supports daily operations and executes fundraising and engagement activities.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

**Development Operations, CRM, & Gift Processing**

  

* Process, record, and acknowledge all gifts, pledges, pledge payments, and in-kind donations accurately and promptly.
* Create and maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date donor and constituent records in Salesforce, including entering new contacts and updating existing information.
* Collaborate with the Director of Development and the Finance department on monthly reconciliation.
* Manage Salesforce data imports, exports, queries, list segmentation, dashboards, and reports to support fundraising, donor engagement, volunteer metrics, and departmental decision-making.
* Conduct regular data audits, maintain CRM documentation and procedures, and identify opportunities to improve data quality, systems, and workflows.

**Development Communications**

  

* Support the execution of our communications plan in coordination with the Director of Development and Vice President of Philanthropy, including drafting and editing fundraising appeals, donor communications, event promotions, impact stories, social media content, and other digital and print materials.
* Coordinate with designers and other vendors on direct mail campaigns, annual reports, event materials, and other collateral.
* Maintain website content and develop, schedule, and publish social media posts across relevant platforms.
* Monitor and report on digital performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement.

**Event Planning & Logistics**

  

* Under the direction of the Director of Development, coordinate and execute logistics for fundraising, donor cultivation, stewardship, and community events, including the annual Community Forward Ball.
* Maintain event databases, guest lists, and communications through Greater Giving, ensuring accurate integration with Salesforce.
* Coordinate assigned day-of event logistics, including setup, guest registration, vendor communications, and Fund-a-Need support.
* Coordinate post-event reconciliation, gift entry, acknowledgments, data cleanup, and reporting in partnership with the Director of Development and Finance.

**Development Coordination & Support**

  

* Coordinate volunteer activities, including recruitment support, logistics, scheduling, and volunteer recognition in collaboration with the Development team.
* Coordinate in-kind donations including maintaining organizational wishlists and managing distribution in collaboration with Programs.
* Conduct prospect and donor research and prepare briefing materials.
* Coordinate scheduling, meeting preparation, and other administrative needs for the Development team and organizational leadership.
* Represent Community Forward SF professionally when interacting with donors, partners, vendors, and other external stakeholders.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE:**

  

* 2-3 years of relevant professional experience in nonprofit development, fundraising operations, database management, communications, events, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
* Commitment to Community Forward’s mission, values, and the communities we serve.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines, and independently manage assigned responsibilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and commitment to maintaining high-quality data and administrative processes.
* Experience with CRM or database systems (Salesforce preferred) and proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for data management and reporting.
* Strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop content for different audiences and build positive working relationships.
* Maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion with sensitive donor and organizational information.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience coordinating nonprofit fundraising events, including vendor logistics, guest registration, and event-related data management.
* Experience with email marketing platforms, website content management systems, and social media management tools.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 15 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role.
* Experience with core cloud computing concepts and enterprise architecture principles, including networking (VPC, peering), compute, storage, IT security (IAM, segmentation, encryption), database systems, cloud-native application development, and operational frameworks.
* Experience presenting to technical and executive stakeholders, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting customers in critical cloud operations domains, including launch/capacity planning, product release management, technical support, or formalized escalation management procedures.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master's degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Relevant technical professional certifications.
* Experience leading technical governance activities, such as establishing or actively participating in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), or developing reference architectures and reusable patterns for an enterprise organization.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Technical Success Account Manager (TSAM), you will serve as a strategic technical leader aligned with Google Cloud’s most critical customers. You are responsible for driving sustained platform health, achieving technical excellence, and ensuring stability for key business critical workloads running on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

The TSAM serves as the customer’s trusted technical advisor, translating complex business objectives into rigorous technical governance and modern, resilient cloud architectural strategies. You will advocate for adoption of industry best practices and act as the primary point of accountability for resolving platform challenges and proactive risk mitigation, to the satisfaction of executive stakeholders.

This role requires independently forging strong executive relationships, advocating for the implementation of Google Cloud architecture standards, elevating platform stability, and establishing technical accuracy across the customer’s GCP footprint, through a programmatic approach. Additionally, you will serve as the internal customer advocate, translating their strategic needs into actionable feedback for Google Cloud’s Product and Engineering teams, ensuring continuous service improvement and feature development.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $224000 - $311000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

* Provide technical guidance and advocate for the adoption of Google Cloud architecture and best practices via deep dives and workshops.
* Drive platform stability and excellence through deep architectural health assessments.
* Serve as the strategic technical advisor to address and resolve critical reliability concerns, advising on and guiding the architecture of highly robust, scalable, and resilient workloads.
* Act as the internal customer advocate, translating technical obstacles to influence GCP product roadmaps. Own workload success, stabilization, and ongoing optimization to ensure sustained business value.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
**Title:** Inbound Sales Development Representative

**Location:** San Francisco, CA (Hybrid)

**Compensation:** $50,000 - $52,500 base + uncapped commission

**Job Type:** Full-time

**About Us**

Demandforce, founded in 2003 and based in San Francisco, is an award-winning software company helping small businesses grow through smarter communication. Our platform includes marketing automation, appointment reminders, reputation management, and 24/7 online booking.

We’re a fast-paced, collaborative team committed to helping businesses thrive—and we’re growing fast! Our Sales Development Representatives work closely with Account Executives to understand prospective customers’ business needs, identify the right opportunities, and create a strong first experience with Demandforce.

**What’s in it for you:**

* $50,000 - $52,500 base salary + uncapped commission
* Paid training + 2-month commission guarantee
* Career advancement path to Account Executive
* Hands-on experience with sales tools and technology, including Salesforce and ZoomInfo
* Ongoing sales coaching and development
* A collaborative, supportive team environment
* Communication, discovery, and sales skills you can build on throughout your career

**Who You Are:**

* Motivated, competitive, and goal-oriented
* A strong conversationalist who can build rapport quickly
* Naturally curious and comfortable asking questions to understand what a prospect really needs
* Comfortable thinking on your feet and navigating unexpected questions
* Organized and able to manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and lead sources at once
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
* Confident on the phone and comfortable communicating through phone, email, and live chat
* Able to recognize buying signals, uncover a prospect’s needs, and confidently guide the conversation toward a next step
* Coachable, open to feedback, and interested in continuously improving
* Resilient - not every conversation results in a meeting. You know when to push, when to pivot, and how to move on to the next opportunity
* Able to work independently and in a team

**How You’ll Do It:**

This is not a traditional cold-calling-only SDR role. You’ll be one of the first people prospective customers speak with when they contact Demandforce.

Throughout the day, you’ll respond to inbound leads from phone calls, website inquiries, live chat, marketing campaigns, and other channels while also completing outbound follow-up. The role averages approximately 65 inbound and outbound calls per day in addition to email and chat activity.

Some prospects will know exactly what they’re looking for. Others may simply know they have a problem they want to solve. Your job is to quickly understand what’s happening in their business, ask the right questions, communicate how Demandforce may be able to help, and determine whether it makes sense to schedule a deeper conversation with an Account Executive.

You’ll need to balance speed with quality. Responding quickly matters, but so does making each conversation count.

* Respond quickly to new inbound prospects and follow up consistently
* Build rapport and lead productive, consultative conversations
* Ask strong discovery questions to understand the prospect’s business, challenges, and priorities
* Identify qualified opportunities and confidently ask prospects to schedule a meeting
* Handle common questions and objections without getting thrown off
* Maintain organized follow-up across calls, email, chat, and sales tools
* Work closely with Account Executives to create a smooth handoff and give them useful context before each appointment
* Learn Demandforce’s products, customers, competitors, and the industries we serve
* Participate in ongoing coaching and development
* Meet activity, appointment-setting, and performance goals

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off + holidays
* FSA for medical and dependent care
* Life & disability insurance

Description:

**Title:** Site Safety and Operations Coordinator  
**Organization:** Boys and Girls Clubs of San Leandro

By maintaining compliance, training staff in emergency procedures, and strengthening site security, the SSOC helps sustain a program where students feel secure and supported, allowing them to fully engage in enriching after-school experiences.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator- Richmond
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for start-up, control, and shut-down of product movements related to marine transfers and overseeing all typical terminal operations on a daily basis at Richmond Terminal. The position is responsible for coordinating operations activities within the Terminal and Phillips 66 Terminal regarding marine transfers. The position has primary responsibility for facility integrity for movements through Terminal piping-systems and storage tanks.

Responsibilities:

This position is the primary contact person for interfacing with Phillips 66/Richmond Terminal for the scheduling and coordinating of all marine related activities. The main contacts are with operations supervisors at the Phillips 66 Terminal. The position is also responsible for emergency response notification and is required to report to various government agencies in the event of an emergency.

The position operates by strict adherence to standard operating procedures and best management practices (BMP), which are based upon requirements set forth by the EPA, California State Lands Commission, USCG, OSPR, BAAQMD, POTW, Richmond Fire Department, Department of Transportation, etc.

* Establish field operations objectives and priorities on a daily basis to meet or exceed customer requirements on a daily basis - consulting with Area Manager and other Operations Coordinators as needed.
* Oversee the safe and environmentally correct transfer of products to and from the Terminal via all modes of transportation (tank-trucks, tank-cars, ocean going tankers, tank-to-tank transfers, blending, etc.).
* Effective communication and interaction with truck drivers, railroad personnel, marine vessel personnel, marine agents, internal/external customers, etc.
* Insure timely completion of all safety inspections required at the Terminal, and the filing of related documentation.
* Oversee staffing requirements related to field operations.
* Maintain an inventory of required operations and safety supplies, restocking as required. Also, working within a budget defined by the Area Manager.
* Maintain and oversee operating standards on a daily basis to ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures and all local, state and federal regulations.
* Conduct and participate in SOP, environmental, health and safety training of operators as required. Assure that operators adhere to the training schedule.
* Assist with facility inspections by various city, county, state and federal regulatory agencies, including BAAQMD, POTW, USCG, California State Lands Commission, OSPR, etc.
* Conduct a minimum of three security checks on arriving tank-trucks on a daily basis and document accordingly.
* Maintain records regarding storm water discharges.
* Maintain records regarding hazardous waste generated as a result of Terminal operations.
* Perform Customer Service Representative duties after hours when needed.
* Perform lab analysis of specific products during off-hours and weekends.

  
Qualifications:

**Minimum requirements:**

**Education:**

* High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

**Experience/specific Knowledge:**

* Two to four years related experience within the terminal industry is required.
* Knowledgeable of storage tank operations, piping-system operations, valves, pumping rates and pressures.
* Must be knowledgeable of all procedures affecting marine transfers and tank farm operations, including piping-system line-ups, operating rates and pressures, line control techniques, pump types and operation, and product characteristics.

**Certification, licenses, registrations:**

* A satisfactory driving record as determined by the Company and a current, valid State driver's license are required.
* If the employee is subject to license or certification requirements or training as stipulated by local, state or federal agencies or the Company, now or in the future, compliance is required under this job description.
* Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) required and is a condition of employment.

**Competencies, skills, and abilities:**

* The Operations Coordinator needs to be familiar with Richmond Terminal’s emergency response plans in order to initiate emergency response. Familiarity with product characteristics affecting emergency response is also required.
* The Operations Coordinator must be familiar with product specifications for all products stored at Richmond Terminal.
* Proficiency with computer applications, including Microsoft Excel, Word, Project, and Outlook.
* Well-balanced interpersonal skills and strong verbal and written communications skills are required.
* Must be accountable and take direction from Managers; keep required work schedules, which include regular and predictable job attendance; focus attention on details and follow work rules.
* Organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks are essential.
* Must be a problem solver with the ability to find resolutions.
* + Must be self-motivated and capable of working with minimal supervision and/or direction.
  + Must be flexible and able to work effectively in a team environment and consistently maintain a professional and respectful demeanor/attitude with co-workers, clients, vendors, and regulatory agencies.

**Physical demands:**

* Employee must be physically capable of completing and satisfying all training requirements as stipulated by local, state or federal agencies and/or Company Policy.
* Exposure to smells and fumes associated with refined petroleum products.
* Work is performed predominantly outside in varying and sometimes extreme weather situations.

**Working Conditions:**

* 8 hour non-rotating shifts (including holidays, weekends); dayshift, swing-shift, grave-yard or modified grave-yard.
* Position subject to 24-hour call-out and unscheduled overtime including nights, weekends, and holidays.
* Must carry a company issued cell phone at all times and answer as needed.
